geo_basis: country only: the article gives no city
date_note: Listing posted 25 November per Daily Security; first detected by RansomLook at 23:00 UTC that day.
title: The Gentlemen ransomware group claims Nadic Games (NADDIC GAMES) on its leak site
summary: Daily Security reports that the ransomware group The Gentlemen listed Korean game developer NADDIC GAMES, maker of CLOSERS, as a victim on its leak site on 25 November. Daily Security says an actual intrusion, the scale of data theft and any leak of player data are not confirmed. The article reports no response from the company.
plain: A ransomware group says it hacked a Korean game developer. Daily Security says no break-in or data theft has been confirmed.
exec: An unconfirmed claim against a game developer; Daily Security says player-data exposure is unconfirmed.

validation.note: Single publisher (Daily Security); the attacker's claim is not confirmed by the company.
